Selected Work — 01 / 02

Executive Assistant Copilot

An AI-powered dashboard inside SAP Concur that helps executive assistants manage travel bookings, expense reports, and approval requests across multiple executives — all from a single workspace.

Role
UX Design Lead
Platform
SAP Concur
Year
2026
Status
Discovery & User Testing
Currently in discovery phase — conducting user testing sessions with executive assistants at Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, and Pfizer. Design is iterated directly based on feedback from each session.
Overview Dashboard — A unified task view showing urgency levels, delegate status, and real-time activity feed.
Travel Management — Upcoming trips for all delegates with one-click booking confirmation and hotel cards.
Request Library — Centralized expense requests per delegate with status indicators and quick-action buttons.
AI Copilot Panel — Contextual AI suggestions surface missing receipts, policy flags, and next best actions inline.
1 / 4

Selected Work — 02 / 02

SAP Joule — Post-Trip Management

A conversational AI experience inside SAP Joule that lets business travelers view active and past trips, manage itineraries, share trip details, and take action — all through natural language, without navigating menus.

Role
UX Design Lead
Platform
SAP Joule
Type
Web / Conversational AI
Year
2026
Joule Home — Natural language entry point — users ask about trips, get quick-action chips to book, manage, or view upcoming travel.
Upcoming Trips — Conversational trip list with full itinerary cards — airline, hotel, dates, record locator, all surfaced in one response.
Trip Detail — Single-trip view with smart action chips — change date, cancel, or add a booking without leaving the chat.
Flight Lookup — Joule answers "What's my next flight?" with structured flight cards and proactive follow-up suggestions.
1 / 4

View Active & Past Trips

Ask Joule about upcoming or previous trips and get structured itinerary cards instantly.

Manage Trips

Change dates, add bookings, or cancel — all through natural language with confirmation flows.

Share Trips

Share full itinerary details with colleagues or assistants directly from the conversation.

Conversational UX

Designed for natural dialogue — quick-action chips reduce typing while keeping the flow contextual.
